plugins.name: Create from Access Database
plugins.description: Imports a Document Model from a Microsoft Access database (.accdb / .mdb). The plugin reads table structure and maps column types to Document Model field types automatically.

plugins.name: Create from Excel
plugins.description: Imports a Document Model from a Microsoft Excel workbook (.xlsx / .xls). Column headers become field names; cell types are sampled to infer the appropriate Document Model field type.
